[[Persepolis F.C.|Persepolis]] were the [[2017–18 Persian Gulf Pro League|defending champions]]. The season featured 13 teams from the [[2017–18 Persian Gulf Pro League]] and two new teams promoted from the [[2017–18 Azadegan League]]: [[Naft Masjed Soleyman F.C.|Naft Masjed Soleyman]] as champions and [[F.C. Nassaji Mazandaran|Nassaji Mazandaran]]. [[Machine Sazi F.C.|Machine Sazi]] replaced [[Gostaresh Foulad F.C.|Gostaresh]]. The league started on 26 July 2018 and ended on 16 May 2019.
